constraints.name: cleanup_jobs_file_id_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (file_id, owner_id) REFERENCES files(id, owner_id)

constraints.name: cleanup_jobs_session_id_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id, owner_id) REFERENCES upload_sessions(id, owner_id)

constraints.name: file_blocks_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((codec = 'raw'::text) AND (encoded_bytes = original_bytes)) OR ((codec = 'gzip'::text) AND (original_bytes > 0) AND (encoded_bytes >= 18))))

constraints.name: file_blocks_session_id_file_id_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id, file_id, owner_id) REFERENCES upload_sessions(id, file_id, owner_id)

constraints.name: file_manifests_session_id_file_id_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id, file_id, owner_id) REFERENCES upload_sessions(id, file_id, owner_id)

constraints.name: files_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'ready'::text) OR ((encoded_payload_bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (stored_bytes = (encoded_payload_bytes + manifest_bytes)) AND (manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_path IS NOT NULL) AND (block_count IS NOT NULL) AND (ready_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: transfer_attempts_block_id_session_id_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (block_id, session_id, owner_id) REFERENCES file_blocks(id, session_id, owner_id)

constraints.name: transfer_attempts_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'present'::text) OR ((observed_bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_verified_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: upload_sessions_file_id_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (file_id, owner_id) REFERENCES files(id, owner_id)
